definitions.explanation: Showing careful and persistent effort in one's work or duties.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{勤勉|きんべん}な⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧だ。
{勤勉|きんべん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{勤勉|きんべん}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Japanese people are said to be hardworking.

notes:
{勤勉|きんべん} describes consistent, dedicated effort in work or study. It is a na-adjective that carries a more formal, literary tone than everyday words like ⟦{真面目|まじめ}→真面目：01206_majime⟧.

FORMS:
- {勤勉|きんべん}な + noun: diligent ~ (modifier)
- {勤勉|きんべん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb: diligently ~ (adverbial)
- {勤勉|きんべん}さ: diligence (noun form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {勤勉|きんべん}な⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧: diligent student
- {勤勉|きんべん}な⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧: hardworking people/nation
- {勤勉|きんべん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work diligently

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{真面目|まじめ}→真面目：01206_majime⟧: serious, earnest (broader — covers attitude, not just effort)
- ⟦{熱心|ねっしん}→熱心：01207_nesshin⟧: enthusiastic, zealous (emphasizes passion)
- {勤勉|きんべん}: diligent (emphasizes steady, consistent hard work)

REGISTER:
Somewhat formal and literary. More commonly used in written language, speeches, and descriptions of national character than in everyday conversation.
